inputs.name: schedule_update
inputs.description: A contractor's schedule update: the chart its scheduling tool exports, as an image, with a time axis, rows of bars and milestones, and a legend

inputs.name: baseline
inputs.description: The master schedule baseline an update is held to: the month each milestone is due, and the tolerance, the rules deciding which slips are flagged

output.description: A contractor's schedule update checked against the baseline: a note for the project manager, then the update's tasks and milestones as rows

fields.name: update
fields.description: What the update is: its schedule and the date of its status line

fields.name: note_for_project_manager
fields.description: Two sentences for the project manager: the milestones that slipped beyond tolerance, by how much and why, then what slipped within it

fields.name: rows
fields.description: Every task and milestone the update shows, in its order, each compared with the baseline where the baseline holds it

fields.name: missing_from_update
fields.description: The baseline milestones the update no longer shows, each flagged; empty when it shows them all
